description: This Java source file defines the class `MappingAndDelegatingCommandConsumer`, a specialized wrapper around an AMQP receiver link used for consuming commands in a tenant-scoped address within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes factory methods for creating instances that handle message reception and link lifecycle events.

classes.name: MappingAndDelegatingCommandConsumer
classes.description: A wrapper class for an AMQP receiver link that handles command message consumption and link lifecycle events.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to asynchronously create an instance of `MappingAndDelegatingCommandConsumer` with specified connection, tenant ID, message handler, and lifecycle handlers.
